prompt: A presentation sheet of EIGHT app icons arranged in a perfectly even grid of 4 columns and 2 rows on one seamless pure white background, wide equal gaps, every object centred in its own invisible cell at the same size. Each icon is a small realistic 3D object rendered like a premium product photo: front view at eye level with only a slight turn, soft studio lighting from the upper left, soft contact shadow, matte and satin materials (paper, ceramic, brushed metal, soft-touch plastic), no glossy plastic, no cartoon. Colourful but calm and harmonised: each object has its own main colour from this palette - deep ink blue #1F2F5C, cobalt blue #2F5BD3, emerald green #1E8C6A, warm amber #E3A33B, violet #6B4FD8, coral #E06A4E - combined with white and light grey. Same lighting, same camera, same material quality for all eight so they clearly belong to one set, like the 3D icon sets of modern fintech apps (Revolut). No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no faces. EXACTLY eight objects in EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows, nothing else on the sheet, absolutely no letters or characters anywhere. Left to right, top row then bottom row: 1) a closed white paper envelope seen from the back with an ink-blue triangular flap; 2) a neat stack of three white invoice sheets, slightly fanned, each with a cobalt-blue band at the top and grey printed lines; 3) a white official form document with an ink-blue header band, grey printed lines and a round violet seal stamped in its lower right corner; 4) a tear-off day calendar block standing upright: a deep ink-blue top binding strip with two small metal rings and below it a thick stack of completely blank white pages (no numbers, no text); 5) a long white paper till receipt standing upright with thin grey printed lines and a zigzag torn bottom edge; 6) a small ink-blue padlock; 7) a round white wall clock with an amber rim and simple hands, no numbers; 8) a white bank statement document with an emerald-green band at the top and grey printed lines.
